$comment: #VAPP-45 (rescoped after #EXP-1458/#EXP-1459): THE PUSH OF A QUESTION CARRIES THE QUESTION TEXT, end to end, sealed. WHICH ASKS PUSH: a question or plan card a ROOT session posts on itself (MCP `exponential_show` ask/plan, a device's `sessions.reply` with a question/plan card), i.e. the session now waits on a person (`needs_input`): a thread root and an agent conversation root (the Assistant's included, #EXP-1439). A CHILD's ask routes to its parent agent (the bus `ask` mirror) and never pushes. A card REPLACED in place (`replace`) does not push again. TO WHOM (`questionPushRecipients`, `routingCases`): the session's OWNER (`sessions.user_id`) alone, never a teammate or a watcher (they see only the needs-you state). TYPE: the issue-less `agent_message` row routed to the session (inbox-route.json), so the existing type prefs (mute) and the 30 s title+body dedupe apply. TITLE (`questionPushTitle`, `titleCases`): an Assistant conversation = `copy.assistantTitle` (agent-settings.json `copy.decisionPush`), anything else = `copy.title` with the session's title. BODY on the row and the push: a PLAINTEXT card = `questionPushText(askText)` of the server's own bus `askText` (lib/sessions/bus.ts); a SEALED card = `copy.genericBody` (the server never opens it; the inbox row keeps the generic copy). DATA: the usual `{type, sessionId, teamId, teamSlug, notificationId, userId}` plus `dataKeys.rootId` (the tree whose key opens it; = sessionId for a root) and, for a sealed card whose device sealed an `askText` to its own tree, `dataKeys.sealedText` = that envelope VERBATIM (`exp-sealed:v1:<epoch>:…`, sealed-content.json BODY ENVELOPE; the epoch rides inside). Only ciphertext ever leaves the server: Postgres (the notifications row), logs and the push payload never hold the plaintext question of a sealed card. SIZE: the push is push-sealed per phone (`{title, body, data}`, 3072 bytes sealed, push-seal.json); over the cap `sealedText` is dropped FIRST (the phone then shows the push body), then the usual degrade steps (body cut, non-routing keys dropped, title cut). The legacy plaintext /send shim never carries `sealedText`. ON THE PHONE (`questionPushBody(data, keysFor, fallback)`, `bodyCases`; iOS = the Notification Service Extension with the shared-keychain TreeKeyStore, Android = FcmService with its key holder): `sealedText` and `rootId` present, the tree's keys held, `openBody` = `opened` → the shown body = `questionPushText(text)`; anything else (no sealedText, no rootId, no keys for that tree or epoch, refused, malformed, unsupported) → `fallback` = the push's own body, unchanged. The title is never replaced. `questionPushText(askText)` (`textCases`) = THE chat ask preview of an `ask` mirror whose body is that text (chats.json `askPreview`: a plan lead = `Plan: ` + the plan's first block, else `Question: ` + the first line with text minus `Asks: `, plainLine), then cut to `bodyMax` code points (`bodyMax - 1` kept + `…`). Secrets in `keys` are lowercase hex, by epoch; `keys` null = this phone holds no key for the tree. Mirrors: TS src/question-push.ts (the reference), iOS ExpPush QuestionPush.swift, Android push/QuestionPush.kt replay `textCases` and `bodyCases`; the server replays `routingCases` and `titleCases`.
